acceptance: Release eligibility identifies v0.5.56 as the sole next patch after immutable v0.5.55 on synchronized origin/main.
A same-SHA v0.5.56 rehearsal succeeds without creating a tag, provider Release, or public asset and emits a source-bound receipt.

The actual release workflow consumes the rehearsal receipt and creates v0.5.56 with the exact tag target, stable provider Release, named assets, archive hash, SBOM, provenance, installer digest, and release-digests correlation verified.
A fresh Git repository invoking v0.5.56/install.sh with AI_COCKPIT_TEMPLATE_REPO=https://github.com/spirex-ds-dev/ai-cockpit-template.git records a v0.5.56 release identity before target writes.

After archive and PR merge, ai-close-work-item reports this exact Work Item's local and remote branch deleted; the archived Outcome states that public-main projection synchronization is an immediate successor requirement.
guidelines: Do not bypass release.yml or manually mutate immutable release objects.
Keep candidate state, tag, provider assets, release-digests, and installer evidence distinguishable and source-bound.
Do not claim future-adopter default discovery until the post-publication main projection and a fresh discovery installation have passed.

intent.problem: The source repair for full public HTTPS Git installer URLs is merged, but future adopters cannot receive it until it is published as immutable v0.5.56 assets and verified from a clean target repository.
constraints: Publish exactly v0.5.56 from synchronized origin/main only after same-SHA rehearsal, preserving v0.5.50 through v0.5.55 unchanged.
Retain all quality, coverage, security, release, installer, smoke, and failure-evidence gates; a failed or canceled operation must remain red with recovery evidence.
Prove the full HTTPS Git URL installer path against immutable v0.5.56 assets; do not treat an ordinary cache hit or tag existence as publication proof.
After this release, create an immediate successor to synchronize public main discovery to v0.5.56 and prove the documented default installation path before closing Issue #783.
intent.rationale: Only a source-bound immutable release can deliver the performance and installer correctness benefit to projects installed in the future; keeping the public projection step separate prevents repeating a stale release.json claim.

declaredIntent.summary: Deliver the merged installer repair and measured quality-path performance benefit to future adopter projects through one verified immutable v0.5.56 release.

authorityEvidence.scope: Publish only v0.5.56 after readiness, exact-source rehearsal, controlled release workflow, immutable tag, provider assets, direct future-adopter installer proof, and final Work Item cleanup pass. No gate bypass, historical-tag mutation, or blind retry is authorized.

rollbackNote: Do not alter an immutable tag or published Release. If rehearsal or publication validation fails, retain its evidence, leave the attempted release unpublished or quarantined as the workflow requires, repair through a successor Work Item, and advance to a new patch only when required.
